p: O thou fairest among women: Hearing of the excellency of Christ, the faithful desire to know how to find him.
garden: That is, is conversant here in earth among men.
Tirzah: Which was a fair and strong city, 1Ki 14:17.
Turn away thy eyes from me: This declares the exceeding love of Christ toward his Church.
sixty queens: Meaning that the gifts are infinite which Christ gives to his Church: or that his faithful are many in number.
Who is she that looketh forth: He shows that the beginning of the Church was small, but that it grew up to a great multitude.
garden of nuts to see the: He went down into the synagogue to see what fruits came from the law, and the prophets.
Before I was aware: I found nothing but rebellion.
like the chariots of Amminadib: Or, Set me on the chariots of my willing people.
Shulamite: O ye people of Jerusalem, for Jerusalem was called Shalem which signifies peace.
